question: How many home claims came through each sales channel in the first half of 2026?

report.interpretation: Home claims counted by loss date (the agreed claim_count metric), from 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30. They are grouped by the sales channel of the policy. This period ends well before the extract date of 2026-09-30, so late reporting has little effect on it.
report.answer: There were 783 home claims with a loss date in H1 2026. Partner had 281, agent 267, direct 138 and online 97. Partner and agent together account for about 70% of the total.
report.answer_sql: SELECT p.channel, count(*) AS claims FROM claims c JOIN policies p USING (policy_id) WHERE c.loss_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' AND c.product='home' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

tool_calls.sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT channel, count(*) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
  AND product IN ('home')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
